items.text: My teacher keeps saying Herzberg's two-factor theory is "contested" but our notes just give the hygiene-factors-vs-motivators list and move on.
Can you explain it properly: what the actual study was (who did it, when, roughly how many people, what method), what it found, and why he says satisfaction and dissatisfaction aren't opposites?
Then the part I'm actually stuck on: is pay a motivator or not?
Who is right, and what is the real evidence either way?
Please also tell me which bits are genuinely disputed vs settled, and who says what, so I don't write something a marker crosses out.

It's for a 10-mark "Discuss" question on whether financial rewards are the best way to motivate crew in a fast-food chain, so finish with how I'd structure that answer (I only need the plan, not a full essay).
